# Nigeria flood — `nga-flooding`

This is the endorsed 2026 revision of Nigeria's flood anticipatory action framework, focused on **Adamawa state** along the Benue river. The action trigger is a **multi-gauge consensus design**: fires when ≥6 of 10 selected Google GRRR gauges simultaneously exceed their individual 4-year return-period threshold, replacing the 2025 single-station OR logic (GloFAS OR GRRR at one Wuroboki gauge). A **GloFAS readiness trigger** (ensemble reforecast mean > 3,132 m³/s at Wuroboki, lead time ≤13 days) gives partners advance notice ahead of the action trigger, **OR**-ed with a GloFAS reanalysis branch that the document mandates (§5.1.1) and the code implements. The **NHF flash-flood** component (observational, BAY states) is retargeted for 2026 to 4 LGAs (Mobbar, Maiduguri, Jere, Geidam — NiHSA composite score) with new per-LGA FloodScan-exposure thresholds from the framework document, validated against the operational data (equal per-LGA probability, combined ~3.5-yr RP). Email dispatch now runs through **Listmonk/ocha-relay** rather than raw SMTP. The document pre-arranges **$6M** (CERF $5M to WFP, IOM, UNICEF, WHO, FAO; NHF $1M to LESGO, NRCS, HARAF) plus $2M WFP co-financing, to protect up to **764,864 people** in the seven LGAs; CERF funds are valid for two years (2026 and 2027 seasons, "until mid-2028"), NHF by end 2026. As of **2026-08-10/11 the full 2026 design is merged to `main` and live**: `monitoring.yml` (riverine) runs daily at 20:00 UTC and `flash-monitoring.yml` runs daily at 01:30 UTC (timed to the floodexposure chain), both with `STAGE=prod`; each stream's production audience is deliberately limited to two team members (soak test) pending migration of the full distribution list.

**Current version:** [2026-07-27](2026-07-27.md) · status: **endorsed** · repo `ocha-dap/ds-aa-nga-flooding`
